_evidence: FINAL mapping for the AsiaMaterialsBrief legacy import (amb-launch W2). No site id, no image host: those live in the owner-held overlay ~/amb-private/overlay.json. Decided 27-10-26 by the owner ("ok" to the proposals) from the discovery result (01-discover-amb.sql run in the globaltravelpost SQL Editor 27-10-26: site asiamaterialsbrief (id in the overlay only), 14 sites in the DB; 440 rows = 252 published, 164 archived (161 never published), 24 draft; created_at 2026-08-08 to 2026-10-27, 439/440 with non-zero microseconds, 0 duplicate instants; 0 null, duplicate or bad slugs; section and subsection values are SLUGS, not the ?sub= display names, so the name variants of the provisional mapping are gone; 428 featured images on the old Supabase storage host, 12 none or relative; 1684 body sections, 0 body images; 2258 distinct legacy tags (3222 uses on 439 rows), none equal to an approved tag; 0 media_assets rows for this site; no intelligence, exhibition, events-awards or press-room article rows). (1) status: published only (252); archived, draft, scheduled, rejected are SKIP; catch-up runs before cutover pick up what the old site publishes after the first run. (2) categories: legacy subsections equal to a new sub-section slug pass through 1:1 (briefing industry-news, people-firms, policy-trade, projects-pipeline; interiors-ffe decor-ose, furniture, kitchen-bath, soft-ffe; lighting-tech building-systems, lighting; materials architectural, surfaces, wood-panels; projects home-renovation); lighting-tech/smart-building goes to smart-building-home; materials/new-sustainable goes to new-sustainable-materials (the new slugs are also mapped, for catch-up runs); projects with an empty subsection resolves through projects/* (pillar, no sub-section); every pillar keeps a <pillar>/* fallback to the pillar with no sub-section. (3) projects/design-voices (59 published rows) goes to projects with NO sub-section: those rows are AI-written project news, not interviews, and Design Voices is reserved for editor-written profiles and Q&A; projects/specified (no rows) goes to projects with no sub-section for the same reason (editor-only, names real suppliers). press-room/* goes to press-room with no sub-section (single-home). intelligence, exhibition and events-awards have no entry on purpose (pages, not pillars; no rows): unmapped is reject. (4) authors: even split over the 6 staff names of the Team page (mode even, per-author counts differ by at most 1, like agr: 252 rows = 42 each); legacy bylines are not kept; catch-up runs keep the Central author of rows already imported. (5) tags: only the 6 approved tags survive; all 2258 legacy tags are dropped (none match, so no renames). (6) media.bodyImages: drop (none exist); the old image library has no rows for this site, so nothing goes to the content-engine Media Engine. (7) archivedAs: section (301 to the article section page, not 410), as agr; archived rows are SKIP anyway. (8) body: reflowMaxChars 380 as aer/agr (same legacy platform: each section is stored as one block and split into paragraphs at render time). Old origin is the apex https://asiamaterialsbrief.com, article path /article/{slug}, section paths /briefing, /materials, /interiors-ffe, /lighting-tech, /projects, /press-room. Pages without articles get no rule from this mapping (as agr: extraLegacyPaths and gonePaths stay empty, the builder only knows GTP static pages): /intelligence, /exhibition, /exhibition/get-listed, /events-awards, /press-room-submit and /editorial-standards keep the same path on amb-web (no redirect needed); /pro 301 to /intelligence and /studio 301 to /about are hand-written in amb-web at cutover; old booth pages /exhibition/<booth> belong to the separate booths step (01b-inspect-amb-booths.sql).
